# STATUS.md — Checkpoint Handoff Log

**How to use:** The Orchestrator updates this file at every checkpoint. Workers report their status to the Orchestrator; the Orchestrator records it here. Keep it short; link PRs or files instead of pasting code.

**Do not edit this file from a worker worktree.** It is owned by the Orchestrator in the main worktree; parallel edits cause merge conflicts.

**Checkpoints:** H+12, H+24, H+32, H+38, H+42 (freeze), H+46 (submit).

## Audit Phase 4 continuation: archive-first (2026-11-14)

API **1.5.0**, repository policy **v1.7**. Default requests now fetch IRSA DR1/QR3, with corrected catalog coordinates and explicit partial/single-epoch limitations. Saved revision-3 products remain unchanged and opt-in. Source/input receipts and stricter full-aperture/local-sky eligibility distinguish fresh, unsupported and historical measurements. No generated observations or fallback products are shipped.

Independent science: all eight fixed region/detector searches completed. Six evaluable groups contain 32 comparisons of 27 stars across four fields, two detectors and DR1+QR3. The existing center-pixel/constant-WCS secondary baseline passes all six; the proposed exact/SAPM primary method fails one and is not adopted. Two groups are insufficient. This establishes restricted evidence, not universal photometric accuracy. The original worst crowded-field residual fails the new annulus-support rule; historical failures remain preserved.

All ten named-target live endpoints passed with verified fresh-input receipts. Image method 11 adds content-addressed asset URLs so later refreshes cannot change earlier result pixels. Current-source image/finite/null strict replay and partial public reacquisition are documented separately.

Final backend suite: **275 passed, no skips**, one dependency deprecation warning. See [current verification](docs/verification/phase4-online-verification.md) for online/replay results and [fixed scientific report](docs/verification/phase4-science-online-verification.md) for scope. Phase 5 UI overhaul, human comprehension checks, publication and Phase 6 container/deployment acceptance remain.

## Audit Phase 3 (2026-11-14)

Implemented separate display/measurement paths, masking before interpolation, supported scalar/2D backgrounds, exact retained-grid spectral matching, one exposure per band/epoch with a 30-day composite span, actual date ranges, and approximate background uncertainty. Independent real-input audits cover raw photometry, Table 16, CWAVE/CBAND, target coordinates and Gaia-versus-image astrometry. Policy v1.5 and API 1.3.0 document stricter background eligibility; field types are unchanged.

**Scientific acceptance has not passed.** The candidate-control comparison fails its fixed stability limits; nine representative exposures pass astrometry and one lacks three suitable stars. Published astrometry places WISE 0855 about 3.6 arcseconds from the frozen query position; R Draconis proper motion also needs correction. Runtime warnings disclose these issues. Saved real products remain unchanged pending the coordinated Phase 4 correction/rebuild. See [Phase 3 evidence](docs/verification/phase3-verification.md).

Verified: **184 backend tests pass, no skips** with the downloaded audit inputs; frontend typecheck/build, real-data rejection tests, 1,458 Astropy WCS comparisons, and the API 1.3.0 null-measurement rendering check pass. The real-only package scanner passes with built frontend assets, and all **288 approved real-cache files remain unchanged**. Container and full browser release verification remain Phase 5 work.

## Audit Phase 2 (2026-11-14; historical checkpoint)

Implemented exact frontend TAN conversion, bounded TAP pagination, remaining-budget SIA fallback, live candidate-epoch comparison, and sharing of concurrent identical builds within one process. Default selection searches three epochs and up to three visits per band, retaining two only when their sampled wavelengths are compatible. Full-set epoch IDs remain stable. API schema remains 1.2.0; repository execution policy is v1.4.

The coordinate implementation passes 1,458 independent Astropy comparisons over 18 fields, including poles and RA wrapping. Live retrieval and timing results, test counts, and remaining gates are recorded in [Phase 2 verification](docs/verification/phase2-verification.md). Implementation does not establish successful arbitrary-field temporal retrieval everywhere: network failures and the synchronous budget must be distinguished from absent coverage. The five saved target datasets are unchanged; their scientific revalidation remains in Phases 3-4.

**Trigger:** the challenge Resources tab was published/updated **2026-11-13 03:46 UTC**. Full findings and links: [`docs/reference/resource-release-2026-11-13.md`](docs/reference/resource-release-2026-11-13.md).

### Released
- **NASA:** IRSA SPHEREx resources, SPHEREx Tutorial Notebooks (now DR1-based), WiseView, Gaia DR3.
- **CSA partner resources:** NEOSSat overview, CADC, NEOSSat Data Tutorial, NEOSSat Dataset.

### Verified on 2026-11-13
- TAP returned **DR1 + QR3 only** for the five targets (no `/qr2/` rows in the query).
- **WISE 0855: 258 DR1 artifacts, 0 QR3** — no longer QR2-only. Barnard 239 DR1 + 119 QR3; Epsilon Indi B 338 + 120; RW Aurigae 226 + 109; R Draconis 1,638 + 855.
